tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: All ASRTU Rate Contract Holders for the tendered item are eligible to participate OR Manufacturers or Importers or Authorised Dealers or Authorised distributor for the tendered item with an average annual turnover of Rs. 1.5 Crores for the preceding Continuous three years (2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25) are eligible to participate in the tender duly supported by the audited statement of accounts i.e., manufacturing/Trading and Profit loss account balance sheets for all the three years and Certificate of verification of turnover issued by the CA in support of Turnover declared in the prescribed format given with Tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- SUBMIT THE DOCUMENTS AS PER THE PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA OF THE TENDER.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Additional Format duly filled, sealed & signed
Any other documents in respect of Prequalification certiria and other Terms and conditions of tender.
ARAI/VRDE/ICAT or CIRT Approval Certificate for Retro-Reflective tape Without QR Code
Audited Statement of Accounts-Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet-for preceding Continuous three years 2022-23,2023-24,2024-25

Certificate of Incorporation/ Certificate of Registration issued by the Registrar of Companies/ Industries and Commerce Dept in proof of manufacturing status-along with MOA or Annexures/ enclosures to certificate-Showing nature of Business / Service /Product rendered / manufactured
Certification of Verification issued by the Chartered Accountant in the format prescribed
Declaration-I as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/- or or above

Declaration-II as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/- or above-In case the manufacturers/ Principal firm will execute supplies through their Channel Partner/ Authorized Dealer/ Distributor
Declaration-III as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/- or above.
In case of Importers, they should enclose supporting documents for the same. i.e, Import licence copy & bill for having the procured tendered items.
MSME Certificate/ Udyog Aadhar certificate / NSIC Certificate / SSI Certificate etc.
NSIC certificate-to avail exemption from the payment of Earnest Money Deposit
Relevant type approval for the tendered items from the certified agencies conformity to AIS-090.
